title: New era, new possibilities !
quote: As many of us, when the pandemic situation started 1 year ago i have started to use strange tools such as Teams or Zoom. It was new and a bit scary. I was not always comfortable with those new ways of communicating. But after few weeks of using Teams i felt more confident. Thanks to the training, i could learn more how to sit, positioned myself, speak and interact with my co-workers. But the most important : i got many constructive information on how to join technology and knowledges to continue doing my work and be able to sell. As you said Martin, the key is to practice :-) Thanks for a very interesting training and i will try to make the best of it.
author: stéphanie macorat
subject: Communication Skills
